# Conventions — lesson pages, components, and data

Everything is designed so a new lesson is: *copy the previous one, replace the
content*. These are the rules that keep 4+ lessons consistent.

## 1. Page anatomy (generated by `tools/build_page.py`)

```
<header>               blue banner: kicker / h1 / one-paragraph intro
<div class="levelbar"> radios A2/B1/B2(/C1) — .seg + <input name="niveau">
<aside class="sidepanel">    Sommaire links (#intro…#avous) + lessons nav (injected)
<aside class="ytpanel">      floating video + custom hover controls
<main>
  #intro        .objectifs (one per level) + .astuce (méthode)
  #comprehension  per-level OL + <details> answers
  #vocabulaire    per-level tables (10 rows each)
  #expressions    per-level .expr-grid cards
  #grammaire      per-level G1..G3 .gram-box
  #parle          per-level notes/table with sample buttons
  #exercices      per-level .exo blocks (JSON specs — see §4)
  #avous          per-level .speak production tasks + <details>
<footer>              sources/credits + list of associated files
+ <script src="exos.js"></script> at the very end
```

**Level gating:** every level-specific block carries `data-lv="a2"` (etc.).
The inline script shows only blocks matching the checked radio and sets
`body[data-niveau]`. All four levels must have one block per section —
the jsdom test checks block counts.

**Level accents (CSS vars, in `tools/framework/style.html`):**
A2 green `#1e7a46` · B1 blue `#16357a` · B2 purple `#6b3fa0` · C1 teal `#0e6b62`.
Adding a level = new radio in part1 + `.seg[data-n="x"]` rule + accent var.

## 2. Authored sources — `content/<slug>/src/part1..5.html`

- `part1` head + header + levelbar + panels + intro + compréhension
- `part2` vocabulaire (`part3` expressions, `part4` grammaire+parlé, `part5` exercices+à vous+footer)
- Parts end with `<!--PARTn-->` markers; part5 contains `<!--SCRIPT_HERE-->`.
- The build splices `tools/framework/style.html` + the `exos.css` link into
  `<head>`, and `framework/script.html` at the script marker.

### Speaker buttons (the 🔊 system)
Author them as placeholders; the builder expands them:

- `[[SAY2:term|example sentence]]` → button with `data-say` (term) +
  `data-say2` (example) — used in vocab rows (inside the first `<td>`) and
  expression cards (right of the card title).
- `[[SAY:example sentence]]` → button with `data-say` only — used in
  Français parlé lists/tables.

Pipeline then adds, per button, in order:
`data-audio="audio-<slug>/vNNN.m4a"` (cut clip) and `data-yt="start,end"`
(video jump span, same values as the clip). `vNNN` are assigned **by DOM order**
— inserting/removing buttons anywhere shifts later ids, so re-run the cut
pipeline after any button change.

### Content rules of the house
- **Verbatim alignment**: the displayed sentence must match what is heard in
  the clip (the audio is the ground truth). Light punctuation and dropped "ne"
  are OK; stutters are trimmed with `…` only when unavoidable.
- Register badges: `<span class="badge familier">familier</span>` /
  `badge vulgaire` — use for any non-neutral word (also in registres tables).
- English glosses live in the "Sens (anglais)" column only; everything else in
  French. No emojis anywhere.
- Vocab rows: 10 per level; expressions: 4 (A2) / 6; parlé: 3–5 examples.
- French typography: « » for quotes, ’ (or ') consistently, … for ellipses.

## 3. Conjugation tooltips (`content/<slug>/add_conjugations*.py`)

Copy the previous lesson's script, edit `PAGE`, `VERBS`. Each verb entry:
`match` (exact cell text before the button), `wrapped` (the word(s) shown with
the dotted underline), optional `suffix` (text kept outside the span),
`aux`, `rows` = 6 persons × [présent, passé composé, imparfait, futur,
subjonctif]. The script reverb-injects idempotently (`<span class="verb">`
wrapping, tooltip `.conj` grid). Anchors like `engueuler (qqn) <span` are
needed when a badge intervenes between the term and the button.

## 4. Interactive exercises — `exos.js` spec format

```html
<div class="exo"><script type="application/json">{
  "id": "xx-b1-1",
  "type": "match" | "fill" | "choice",
  "title": "Exercice 1 — …",
  "instructions": "…",            // optional
  // match:                      // fill:                 // choice:
  "pairs": [                     "items": [{             "options": [...],  // shared
    {"left": "…", "right": "…"}    "prompt": "…",        "items": [{
  ]                                "answers": ["…","…"],  "prompt": "… ___ …",
                                   "open": true           "correct": ["…"]}]
                                 }]
}</script></div>
```

- **match** = click-to-connect: click a left item, then its right counterpart;
  pairs get numbered badges; re-click to undo. Right column is shuffled.
- **fill** = typed answers; the first `___` in the prompt becomes an inline
  input (no `___` → input below the prompt). Accepts several variants.
  Verdict tiers: exact (green) → accents/apostrophes/apostrophe-spacing
  tolerant (orange *« Presque ! »*) → wrong (red, shows the expected answer).
  `"open": true` = free production: any non-empty answer shows the model
  answers, counted separately ("à comparer").
- **choice** = `<select>` dropdowns; auto-checks on change; multiple accepted
  values allowed in `correct`.
- Every block renders **Corriger / Recommencer** + a score line, and dispatches
  `document` event `exo-graded` `{id, type, score, total, almost}` — the future
  progress-tracking hook.

## 5. Per-lesson data — `content/<slug>/`

- `transcript_raw.json` (opinions) or `transcript-<slug>.json`: YouTube caption
  segments `{start, dur, text}`. `*.txt` = the same, paragraph-wrapped for reading.
- `clip_overrides.json`: `{"v001": [start, end], …}` — final **absolute seconds**
  into the video for every button (source of truth for both the m4a clip and the
  `data-yt` span). Curated via `tools/map_spans.py` + manual word-timing lookups.
- `spans.json`: last cut report written by `cut_clips.py` (debugging aid).
- Media (served): `audio-<slug>/vNNN.m4a` (mono AAC, 64–96 kbps),
  `video_src-<slug>/lesson_video.mp4` (480p/360p h264+aac, ≈6–60 MB).

## 6. `lessons.json` (registry)

```json
{ "file": "lecon-<slug>.html", "nav": "Short label for sidebars",
  "ep": "Kicker chip (e.g. « Easy French 259 »)", "title": "Card title",
  "desc": "Card description", "levels": "A2 · B1 · B2", "video": "YouTube URL" }
```

`tools/add_lessons_nav.py` regenerates `index.html` from it and (re-)injects
the "Leçons" side-panel block + footer line into **every** registered page
(idempotent, marker-based: `<!--LESSONS_NAV-->` / `<!--LESSONS_NAV_FOOT-->`).

## 7. Known pitfalls (learned the hard way)

- Injection anchors must be **section-scoped**: lesson 1's quote injector once
  matched an identical quote in another section and scrambled all button ids.
- `git`/deploy: root files are the site — never rename site-level assets
  without updating pages + `lessons.json` + scripts.
- After any button (re)generation always run, in order:
  build → conjugations → cut_clips → add_youtube → add_lessons_nav.

## 8. Progress & spaced repetition (`srs.js`, `progres.html`)

- Storage: localStorage key `fr-lessons-progress-v1`, doc =
  `{v, created, lastOpen, items: {"<lessonFile>|<data-say>": {st, due, ivl,
  ease, reps, lapses, last, meta}}, activity: [...]}`.
- Item sources: cards enter the deck **explicitly** — nothing registers on page
  open or level change. Two triggers: (a) clicking a `.say` on a vocab row /
  expression card adds that one card; (b) the « + Ajouter ces N … » button that
  `srs.js` injects into each visible level's `.lead` opens a **selection mode**:
  a checkbox per row/card (all checked; items already in the deck are shown
  checked + disabled), the button becomes « Ajouter la sélection (N) » with a
  live count, « Annuler »/Échap exits without adding — so items can be excluded
  before adding. Keys are the `data-say` strings, so keep them unique within a
  lesson.
- `progres.html` never auto-registers either: an empty deck shows a button to
  add the whole catalog (205 cards), and a « Réinitialiser » button clears the
  local doc.
- Review UI is Anki-style: centered card (front = gloss, click/space flips),
  solid graded buttons (g0..g3 red/orange/green/blue) whose `.ivl` span shows
  the simulated next interval (`previewIvl` clones the item and calls
  `SRS.grade`). Keyboard: space/click flips, 1-4 grade, R replays the audio
  (only once flipped, so the French term isn't spoiled). « À venir » forecast = 5 CSS-bar buckets over `doc.items` due
  dates: Auj. (≤ 23:59 today, overdue included), Demain, 2-3 j, 4-7 j, +7 j;
  the Auj. bar gets `.hot` (red) when non-zero; respects the lesson filter.
- Grades 0–3 (Encore / Difficile / Bien / Facile): SM-2-lite — learning steps
  10/15 min, review interval ×ease, ease clamped 1.3–2.8, max 365 days.
- Lesson pages log `exo-graded` results into the activity log.
- Optional sync, Google-account-based: `config.js` holds the public
  `workerUrl` + `googleClientId`; the page obtains a Google ID token (GIS) and
  stores it in localStorage `fr-lessons-session` (`{idToken, sub, email, exp}`).
  `SRS.auth()` = config + non-expired session. Every push is **GET → merge →
  PUT** (a stale device can't clobber the server), with a busy queue and a
  401 → `auth` result that clears the session and asks to reconnect; sync runs
  on save (debounced 2.5s), on progres.html load, and on window focus (both
  pages). When signed in, lesson pages show a small round photo chip
  (`#account-chip`, bottom-right, rendered by `srs.js`) linking to progres.html. `fr-lessons-sync-last` holds the last successful sync time.
  Merge = latest `last` wins per item, activities are unioned; `wipedAt`
  (set by « Réinitialiser ») drops items/activity older than the wipe on every
  device. The Worker (`cloudflare/worker.js`) verifies the Google JWT (JWKS
  RS256, aud/iss/exp) and keys the D1 row by `sub`.
- `progres.html` is generated (deck embedded as JSON) by
  `tools/build_review.py`; regenerate after any content edit (also run
  automatically at the end of `tools/add_lessons_nav.py`).
